purpose: Place look study (#9992), a test aid: the tallest standing stone as three base meshes x two paint routes, each a prop mesh at 32 texels/m. Built in asset-pipeline live-evidence/stele-place-study-20261017 (scripts/ there). Bases: a = the current PoiShapes stele distance field, meshed; b = an authored slab in Blender; c = a Qwen concept turnaround edited to plain clay and rebuilt by Pixal3D, rescaled to 1.8 x 1.0 m. Paints: proj = painted views projected back onto the mesh (a, b: Qwen repaints of rendered views after the c concept; c: the detailed concept views themselves); stamps = a calm painted stone tile with authored ceramic ring, band and chips. Texture treatments of c (optional "texture" overrides the mesh's own): clean = the concept projected over a flat stone base (no tile leftovers); pixel = clean reduced as pixel art (dark line texels kept crisp, 14-colour palette plus 3 accent colours); pixelpaint = the concept views redrawn by Qwen as pixel art, projected and reduced the same way.
